description: My enemies are many. My equals are none. In the shade of olive trees, they said Italy could never be conquered. In the land of pharaohs and kings, they said Egypt could never be humbled.

desc.en: The Shaanxi KJ-2000++ (Chinese: 空警-2000; pinyin: Kōngjǐng Liǎngqiān; lit. 'Airwarning-2000', NATO reporting name: Mainring) is a Chinese second-generation airborne early warning and control (AEW&C) aircraft developed by the Shaanxi Aircraft Corporation, and is the first AEW&C system in service to the People's Liberation Army Air Force. It is built upon a modified Russian Ilyushin Il-76 airframe using domestically designed avionics and a fixed radome featuring three active electronically scanned array (AESA) radars each covering a 120-degree sector,[3] unlike the rotating radome on the comparable E-3 Sentry serving the United States Air Force
desc.zh: 空警-2000是陕西飞机公司研制的中国第二代空中预警指挥机，也是解放军空军首个服役的预警指挥系统。以改装的俄罗斯伊尔-76为机体，采用国产航电和固定雷达罩，内装3部各覆盖120度的有源相控阵雷达；与美国E-3的旋转雷达罩不同。
desc.ko: KJ-2000은 산시 항공이 개발한 중국 2세대 공중조기경보통제기이자 중국 공군 최초의 실전 배치 조기경보 체계다. 개조된 러시아 Il-76 기체에 국산 항전 장비와 고정식 레이돔을 사용하며, 각 120도를 담당하는 AESA 레이더 3기를 탑재한다. 미국 E-3의 회전식 레이돔과 다르다.

desc.en: The Xi'an H-20 (Chinese: 轰-20; pinyin: Hōng-20; alternatively Xi'an H-X) is a projected subsonic stealth bomber design of the People's Liberation Army Air Force. It is referred to as a strategic project by the People's Liberation Army,[2][3] and will be the first dedicated strategic bomber developed by China.[

desc.en: J-31 air superiority aircraft Made By China GOOD AT LONG RANGE AIR TO AIR COMBAT AND ALSO AIR TO GROUND COMBAT, SEEING THE ENEMY ALREADY DESTROYED BEFORE THEY GOT CLOSE/The Shenyang J-35 (Chinese: 歼-35; pinyin: jiān-sānwǔ) is a series of Chinese single-seater, twin-engine, all-weather, stealth multirole combat aircraft manufactured by Shenyang Aircraft Corporation (SAC), designed for air superiority and surface strike missions. desc.en: The Type 99 (Chinese: 99式主战坦克; pinyin: Jiǔjiǔshì Zhǔzhàn Tǎnkè) or ZTZ-99 is a Chinese third generation main battle tank (MBT).[6] The vehicle was a replacement for the aging Type 88 introduced in the late 1980s. The Type 99 MBT was China's first mass-produced third-generation main battle tank. Combining modular composite armour and tandem-charge defeating ERA, 125 mm smoothbore gun with ATGM-capability, high mobility, digital systems and optics, the Type 99 represents a shift towards rapid modernization by the PLA.

desc.ko: 99식(ZTZ-99)은 노후한 88식을 대체한 중국의 3세대 주력전차이자 최초의 대량생산 3세대 전차다. 모듈식 복합장갑, 탠덤 탄두 대응 반응장갑, ATGM 발사가 가능한 125mm 활강포, 높은 기동성, 디지털 체계와 광학장비로 인민해방군의 현대화를 보여준다.

desc.en: BRP Gregorio del Pilar (PS-40) is the lead ship of her class of offshore patrol vessel of the Philippine Navy. desc.en: The Soviet Union developed the Project 1155, also referred to as Frigat and Udaloy, class destroyers in the 1970s on the basis of the Krivak class anti-submarine frigate. These ships were designed to engage submarines as their primary target with surface ships being their secondary target. The Udaloy class destroyers sensor suite includes Fregat MA air surveillance radar, hull mounted sonar and variable depth sonar. The propulsion system is based in four gas turbines in a COmbined Gas And Gas (COGAG) arrangement allowing a top speed of 35 knots. desc.en: The Type 99 (Chinese: 99式主战坦克; pinyin: Jiǔjiǔshì Zhǔzhàn Tǎnkè) or ZTZ-99 is a Chinese third generation main battle tank (MBT).[6] The vehicle was a replacement for the aging Type 88 introduced in the late 1980s.
